title: fix(refinement list): prevent error when value has a quote
body:
**Summary**

If the `value` has a `"`, the query selector is invalid and throws an error. This PR fixes that case.

Code introduced in https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/pull/6392 originally. Preact issue still open.

**Result**

we escape (only `"`, other characters have no impact) the value in the query selector, no error is thrown and the correct value is focused.

[CR-7674]
